summary.text: Karrie Delaney is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 9, which covers part of Fairfax County.
Karrie Delaney has been a member since 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Karrie Delaney was born in Tampa, Florida, in 1978.
Karrie Delaney studied at the University of South Florida (B.A., Psychology, 2000).
Karrie Delaney's listed occupation is communication consultant.

Karrie Delaney's listed memberships and affiliations include the Fairfax County Democratic Committee, the Sully Democratic Committee, the Virginia Commission on Youth, and the Fairfax County Library Board.

The House profile lists Karrie Delaney's committee assignments as Transportation (Chair), Courts of Justice, and General Laws, and Karrie Delaney chairs the Professions/Occupations and Administrative Process subcommittee of General Laws.
